deficiency.overview: The source does not establish that a low total-polyunsaturated-fat log diagnoses a particular essential-fatty-acid deficiency.
deficiency.medicalBoundary: Symptoms are nonspecific and cannot diagnose a nutrient deficiency. Diagnosis may require clinical evaluation and appropriate laboratory testing.

excess.overview: FDA discusses replacing saturated fat with unsaturated fat; this is not an unlimited-intake recommendation or an individual safe ceiling.
excess.medicalBoundary: No upper limit is an intake goal. Individual clinical or medical assessment requires a qualified professional.
